description: Single-phase 2D channel between no-slip walls with constant-discharge inflow (B 60 1, W 10 = 0.025 m3/s through the 1 m x 0.05 m inflow, i.e. 0.5 m/s) and outflow. After the projection the velocity must be divergence-free in every cell, including the inflow and outflow columns: max |div u|. Before the inflow fix the inflow column had |div| = 0.29; the remaining ~1e-3 is in the outflow column (outflow velocity boundary condition, not corrected by the projection) - tolerance 2e-3 until the outflow is reworked.
